fields.title: 5. Executive and government statements — recorded only as milestone candidates
fields.md:
| Date | Statement | Cross-check |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-10-06 | Department of Defense spokesperson (NPR): "MITRE is responsible for analysis and recommendations" · "appropriate conflict-of-interest and information-protection safeguards will be applied" · time horizon 10–20 years | The complaint argues that these safeguards do not satisfy FACA requirements — not a basis for a verdict; to be checked via T11 ② |
| 2026-09-30 | Hegseth (speech, as cited by CNBC): Project Meridian is "not about creating a new strategy or new policy" | Difference between the memo (identifying future battlefields, weapons and technologies) and the press release (naming co-directors) — recorded only |
| 2026-10-02 | Anduril statement (Politico): "where real conflicts of interest arise, we pledge to comply with the highest ethical standards" | SpaceX did not respond to the same inquiry — recorded only |

(Source: [NPR 10/06 (WFAE reprint)](https://www.wfae.org/united-states-world/2026-10-06/elon-musk-and-palmer-luckeys-new-pentagon-roles-raise-ethics-worries) · [MIXED 10/02](https://mixed-news.com/en/project-meridian-memo-emil-michael-palmer-luckey-musk/) · [Politico (Yahoo reprint) 10/02](https://www.yahoo.com/news/politics/articles/musk-led-war-commission-triggers-184841551.html) — no statement by Musk himself about Meridian was found in this round's search)
